# PostToolUse Hook Documentation

Hooks intercept tool calls and can compress oversized results before they reach the model.

## Using updatedToolOutput

Return `hookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput` matching the built-in tool's outputSchema. See [Schema Reference](https://docs.example.com/hooks/schema) for Grep, Glob, WebFetch, and WebSearch.

## Error Handling

Always fail open and keep error or warning lines intact.

Hooks intercept tool calls and can compress oversized results before they reach the model.

## Using updatedToolOutput

Return `hookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput` matching the built-in tool's outputSchema. See [Schema Reference](https://docs.example.com/hooks/schema) for Grep, Glob, WebFetch, and WebSearch.

## Error Handling

Always fail open and keep error or warning lines intact.
